purpose: Taguchi-style L8 screening plan around exact execution representations only

control_reference.checkpoint_policy_description: Exact experiment-0000 Gram-only SAC: save the full Gram/QK score work required by the accepted control and recompute non-Gram intermediates; no candidate prefix-read or QK-block-only branch is selected.

randomization.control_interleave: anchor before each block, after every two candidate slots, plus block-end anchor and randomized control row G0-00

analysis.interaction_policy: full foldover de-aliases main effects from two-factor interactions; retain the remaining three-term interaction groups as unresolved and promote only to a full factorial round
analysis.promotion_to_full_factorial: top factors must pass oracle, no memory regression, and have stable sign across randomized blocks
analysis.foldover_policy: use the full foldover to de-alias main effects from two-factor interactions; do not interpret the remaining three-way interaction groups as individually identified
analysis.control_policy: G0-00 must remain an exact 0000/908b0b1 Gram-only SAC control; any mismatch fails closed before GPU execution
